sources.title_en: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo
sources.title_original: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo
sources.recommend_reason_zh: OpenAI and Cisco推出开源运行时Shirudo，帮助团队在打补丁期间保护运行中的Linux系统；受控测试中，Codex生成的shield无需重启便挡住了针对Elasticsearch的Java4Shell攻击。

en.reason: OpenAI and Cisco's open-source Shirudo runtime lets teams keep running Linux systems protected while patches roll out, and in controlled tests a Codex-generated shield blocked a Java4Shell attack on Elasticsearch without a reboot.

sources.title: 密钥扫描减少 Slack 的误报 / Secret scanning reduces false positives for Slack
sources.title_zh: 密钥扫描减少 Slack 的误报
sources.title_en: Secret scanning reduces false positives for Slack
sources.title_original: Secret scanning reduces false positives for Slack
sources.recommend_reason_zh: GitHub 的 secret scanning 现已针对 Slack 密钥降低误报检测，其中 slack_incoming_webhook_url 检测器通过排除特定 URL 来减少误匹配，帮助开发者减少无效告警干扰。

en.reason: GitHub’s secret scanning now cuts false-positive detections for Slack secrets, with its slack_incoming_webhook_url detector excluding certain URLs to reduce mismatches and spare developers unnecessary invalid alerts.

en.title: AI fixes its own drawing mistakes: SenseTime open-sources U1.6, a multimodal model that learns to look back
en.reason: SenseTime open-sourced SenseNova U1.6 on November 24, an 8B open model that first drafts an image, then checks it against the original prompt to catch text errors and redraw, targeting the misspelled-text and skewed-layout rework that frustrates AI image generation.

sources.title: Z.ai 紧随 OpenAI 之后，以全新 750B 旗舰模型进军循环 Transformer 领域 / Z.ai follows OpenAI into loop transformer territory with its new 750B flagship model
sources.title_zh: Z.ai 紧随 OpenAI 之后，以全新 750B 旗舰模型进军循环 Transformer 领域
sources.title_en: Z.ai follows OpenAI into loop transformer territory with its new 750B flagship model
sources.title_original: Z.ai follows OpenAI into loop transformer territory with its new 750B flagship model
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Z.ai 将 750B 参数的 GLM-5.4 改为 28 层跑两次的 loop 架构，号称匹敌 2 至 3 万亿参数模型，但基准仅来自 30B 测试模型，并定位 Generalized Coding。

en.reason: Z.ai's GLM-5.4 uses a loop architecture where 28 layers run twice, which the company claims lets the 750-billion-parameter model match 2 to 3 trillion-parameter models, though benchmarks so far come only from a 30B test model.

en.title: Chatting in a group: for those running AI media accounts, how do you usually find story angles?
en.summary:
Got to talking in a group chat: for those of you doing AI content creation, how do you usually find topic angles?

Let me start with my own situation 👇
I just passed 12,000 followers on Xiaohongshu doing AI content — not explosive growth, and no viral posts with tens of thousands of likes.

But every post performs consistently, and monetization has been running smoothly:

1️⃣ Landed my first sponsored deal with a top model company at 1,000+ followers; from 4,000+ followers I've had back-to-back brand deals every month; at 8,000+ I signed with an MCN (deal referrals only, no content support)
2️⃣ Now I get dozens of collaboration inquiries every month, with a wide range of products (LLMs, office Agents, AIGC, hardware) and solid rates.
3️⃣ Since I have a day job, I take at most three or four a month, and my rates have been climbing over the past few months.

Many people assume brand deals come down to follower count. I think when brands put real money behind a budget, they care more about two things:

- Whether the content has a natural "ad slot…
en.reason: A Xiaohongshu AI creator with just over 12,000 followers recounts landing a first top model-brand deal at 1,000+ followers, monthly deals from 4,000+, an MCN signing at 8,000+, and dozens of monthly invitations, accepting three or four.

en.title: Chatting in a group: for those running AI media accounts, how do you usually find story angles?
en.summary:
Got to talking in a group chat: for those of you doing AI content creation, how do you usually find topic angles?

Let me start with my own situation 👇
I just passed 12,000 followers on Xiaohongshu doing AI content — not explosive growth, and no viral posts with tens of thousands of likes.

But every post performs consistently, and monetization has been running smoothly:

1️⃣ Landed my first sponsored deal with a top model company at 1,000+ followers; from 4,000+ followers I've had back-to-back brand deals every month; at 8,000+ I signed with an MCN (deal referrals only, no content support)
2️⃣ Now I get dozens of collaboration inquiries every month, with a wide range of products (LLMs, office Agents, AIGC, hardware) and solid rates.
3️⃣ Since I have a day job, I take at most three or four a month, and my rates have been climbing over the past few months.

- Whether the content has a natural "ad slot…

en.title: LLM is everything: Why is ByteDance the first to ship a Personal Agent?
en.summary:
LLM is everything: Why was ByteDance the first to serve up a Personal Agent?

Tried ByteDance's newly launched Xiaodou today—the level of polish is higher than expected.
Why was it ByteDance, not Alibaba or Tencent, that first got a Personal Agent out the door?

When it comes to closing the loop between goods and transactions, Alibaba is the ceiling.
Tencent clearly holds the better hand: social relationship chains, user stickiness, and the earliest nationwide rollout of the Workbuddy base.

Because LLM is everything.
Model capability is the foundational bedrock of all AI business.

Ordinary people's personal needs are too scattered and too long-tail—engineers simply can't enumerate them all.
Only when the base model is strong enough does the Agent no longer need so much fine-tuning.
No need to hand-hold it through which button to click first, what to look up second.
Just…
en.reason: ByteDance's newly launched Xiaodou Personal Agent impressed on first use with higher-than-expected completeness, and the piece argues ByteDance beat Alibaba and Tencent because strong foundation models, not fine-tuning, handle messy long-tail personal needs.

Google AI Pro's Black Friday deal may be the best AI bundle of the year! $99.99 for the first year, or about $8.33 a month! Gemini 4 Neon, AI Agent, 5TB of cloud storage, 200 GPU compute units, plus $10 in monthly developer credits!

Folks, this Black Friday, Google's offer deserves a serious look.

Google AI Pro's annual plan is half off at $99.99 for the first year, down from the usual $199.99 a year — a straight $100 savings.

That works out to roughly $8.33 a month.

But what's really worth watching isn't just the discount — it's that Google is gradually bringing AI Agent, its models, cloud compute and developer tools together into one place.

With a single Pro plan, the official details currently confirm…

sources.title_zh: AI音乐周刊 W.A 055
sources.title_original: AI音乐周刊 W.A 055
sources.summary: AI 做音乐正从“生成一首歌”走向完整创作流程，但发布和变现的规则也在收紧。这期《AI 音乐周刊》汇总了 Suno 歌曲转视频、在 AI 助手里直接做歌，以及用对话修改音效、配乐等更新，同时梳理平台对冒名作品、刷量与训练授权的新动向。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: SoundCloud 11月17日新增AI Abuse四类违规，禁止用AI刷量、假充真人并追回分成；本期还收录Spotify、Suno等更新。

en.title: AI Music Weekly W.A 055
en.summary: AI music is moving from "generate a song" toward the full creative workflow, but the rules for releasing and monetizing are tightening too. This edition of AI Music Weekly rounds up Suno's song-to-video feature, making tracks directly inside AI assistants, and updates for editing sound effects and scores through conversation, plus a look at platforms' new moves on impersonation, fake streams, and training licensing.
en.reason: SoundCloud added four AI Abuse violation categories on November 17, barring AI-driven stream manipulation and fake human personas while clawing back payouts, alongside Spotify's artist protection tool and Suno's Visuals, Platinum tier and MCP rollout.

en.title: Gemini Pro is 50% off for Black Friday: $99.99 for a full year
en.summary: Why can some people see $99.99 for the first year on the same Google AI Pro subscription page while others still see the full price? en.reason: Google's Black Friday deal gives Gemini Pro at $99.99 for the first year with access to Gemini 4 Neon, launched November 18, though Jio users must first remove the Google One subscription slot it occupies.

sources.summary: 一个人带 18 个 AI 助手，结果 149 件成果都堵在“等我看”。元子用自己的一人运营部复盘了一个真实困境：AI 产出越快，人的审核和决策越容易成为瓶颈。适合独立创作者和小团队参考，看看如何减少无效确认，把有限精力留给真正需要自己拍板的事。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 作者带18个AI助手、主Bot派活却积压149件待确认成果，对照麦肯锡2到5人看住50到100个智能体，拆解AI原生组织为何堵在等我看这一格。

en.title: One person managing 18 AI assistants—and they all bottlenecked at the waiting-for-my-review stage.
en.summary: One person running 18 AI assistants ended up with 149 deliverables stuck in "waiting for me to look at them." Yuanzi uses their own one-person operation to work through a real dilemma: the faster AI produces output, the more human review and decision-making become the bottleneck. A useful reference for independent creators and small teams on cutting out pointless confirmations and saving limited energy for the calls that truly need to be made by you.
en.reason: A solo operator running 18 AI assistants hit 149 results awaiting confirmation, and this piece compares that bottleneck with McKinsey's claim that 2 to 5 people can oversee 50 to 100 agents.

sources.summary: 员工用 AI 越来越快，项目却还在等审批、等交接，省下的时间又变成了更多材料和会议。这篇沿着“个人助手→办公交付→团队协作”的演进，拆解了一个现实问题：每个人都有 AI，为什么团队仍然忙乱？
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 从OpenClaw 60天GitHub星标破25万，到WorkBuddy截至7月月活658.2万、阿里与字节重组办公Agent，文章追问单点效率为何难成业务突破，并指向企业级Agent OS。

en.title: From Everyone Raising Shrimp to AI Coworkers: Revelations from the 2026 AI Agent Evolution
en.summary: Employees are adopting AI faster and faster, yet projects still sit waiting on approvals and handoffs — and the time saved turns into more documents and more meetings. Tracing the shift from personal assistant to office deliverables to team collaboration, this piece unpacks a real-world question: if everyone has AI, why are teams still so busy?
en.reason: OpenClaw's 250,000 GitHub stars in 60 days, WorkBuddy's 6.582 million July MAU and Alibaba-ByteDance office-agent reshuffles frame AI agents' shift from personal assistant through office delivery to team collaboration, asking why individual speedups fail without an enterprise Agent OS.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 这篇指南把 Theo 在 11 月 9 日至 18 日三款前沿模型发布后组建的团队，展开成 T3 Code 六步搭建流程，并加入 Grok Bot 实现离线派发任务。

en.title: Build a multi-model agent team with T3 Code
en.summary: Using Claude, Codex, and Gemini but still stuck as a middleman shuttling requirements and code between windows? The author uses T3 Code to turn multiple models into a development team, covering setup and configuration, task handoff, permission management, and cross-model review, with reusable team rules and role prompts.
en.reason: T3 Code, a local control layer that launches Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Grok Build agents, is set out in a six-step setup guide that adds a Grok Bot for dispatching tasks while offline, expanding on Theo's team built after three frontier models shipped between November 9 and 18.

sources.summary: AI 生成的 3D 角色看着很帅，一动起来却穿模、滑步，连武器都握不稳？Fini 用一款三国动作游戏，拆解了从单张参考图到电脑、手机双端可玩的完整流程：规范角色图、生成模型与动作、压缩素材，再逐步修好动作细节、补上打击感和Boss战。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章以《暗黑三国·孤枪入夜》为例，拆解从单图绑骨到电脑手机双端60帧试玩的流程，公开9段实测提示词、无损瘦身脚本、防滑步公式和6门禁AI总控指令，全章3D资产成本不到42块钱。

en.title: 🔥 No modeling, no artists: one person used AI to build a full-fledged 3D action game that's genuinely playable—and released the full prompt set, from single-image rigging to a two-platform playable demo
en.summary: AI-generated 3D characters look cool—until they start moving, clipping through themselves, sliding around, or failing to grip a weapon. Using a Three Kingdoms action game, Fini breaks down the full pipeline from a single reference image to a title playable on both PC and mobile: standardizing character art, generating models and animations, compressing assets, then fixing animation details step by step while adding combat impact and boss fights.

sources.title: datasette-agent 0.7a1 改进 iframe 侧面板 fragment 导航

sources.title_en: datasette-agent 0.7a1
sources.title_original: datasette-agent 0.7a1
sources.summary:
An LLM-powered agent for Datasette
24th November 2026
I small improvement to Datasette Agent : chat sessions can open an iframe side panel, and that panel can then navigate to different pages. This version improves navigation by fragment hashes, for deeper integration with other Datasette plugins that update fragment hashes when the user interacts with the plugin in a way that changes state.
I built this in order to fix some bugs with the much more exciting datasette-charts 0.2a0 release .
This
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Simon Willison 为 Datasette 的 LLM agent 发布 datasette-agent 0.7a1，新增可导航的 iframe side panel，并改进 fragment hashes 导航，以便与其他会随用户交互更新哈希的 Datasette plugins 深度集成，同时修复 datasette-charts 0.2a0 的 bug。

en.reason: Simon Willison released datasette-agent 0.7a1, adding an iframe side panel that can navigate pages and improved fragment-hash navigation for deeper integration with Datasette plugins, fixing bugs with datasette-charts 0.2a0.

sources.title_original: 1/7 AI agents don’t browse your product in a straight line. They teleport. Docs, CLI, API, MCP server, browser no shared ID, no session, no trail. Until now. To your product, it looks like a handful of unrelated visitor…
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章指出 AI agents 不按直线浏览，而会在 Docs、CLI、API、MCP server、browser 间“瞬移”，没有共享 ID、session 或 trail，产品端只看到几个互不相关的访客，并发布论文 Following the Agent 讨论如何重建这一过程。

en.reason: AI agents jump between Docs, CLI, API, MCP server and browser with no shared ID, session or trail, so a product sees only unrelated visitors, and the paper "Following the Agent" addresses reconstructing that fragmented path.
